summary: Create timebound, retention-sensitive Confluence space + Slack channel for Legal M&A due diligence with automated daily snapshot exports
description:
Issue summary:
Create a dedicated Confluence space and a corresponding private Slack channel to support an upcoming M&A due diligence window. The space and channel must be timebound (access granted for a fixed window), have strict read/post controls, and produce automated daily immutable snapshots (PDF + export) stored in an S3 bucket for audit.

Business impact:
Legal has a four-week diligence period starting 2026-04-01. They need a secure, auditable collaboration surface where external counsel and internal stakeholders can review documents and discuss items. Current ad-hoc sharing (email + existing spaces) is insufficient for retention guarantees and audit traceability.

Requirements (non-exhaustive):
- Confluence space with:
  - Granular permissions: Legal Lead (A. Singh) and Compliance Admins = edit, core team = comment, external counsel = view-only.
  - Space expiry: automatic deprovision of external accounts and revocation of edit/comment rights after 2026-04-30.
  - Immutable daily snapshot job that exports the entire space to PDF and HTML, signs the export with a deterministic filename (YYYYMMDD_space-dump.pdf) and uploads to our secure S3 bucket (s3://redwood-audit/mna-dd-2026/).
- Slack channel (#legal-dd-2026) private with:
  - Restricted posting: only @legal-team and designated counsel can post; others are view-only.
  - Message retention policy: preserve full message history for 2 years; disable auto-deletion during the window.
  - Channel archival and export on 2026-05-01: export history to S3 in an audit-friendly format and then archive the channel.
- Automation/orchestration:
  - One-time terraform/automation job (or runbook) to create the space/channel, apply permissions, and schedule the daily snapshot + final export.
  - Notify stakeholders in #ops-requests and Legal Slack with links and access checks once provisioned.

Acceptance criteria:
- Confluence space created with correct permission matrix and visible to Legal lead for validation.
- Private Slack channel created with permission restrictions and retention settings verified.
- Daily snapshot job runs and places files in S3 with correct filename format for 3 consecutive days during runbook testing.
- Automation documented in Confluence runbook with step-by-step for emergency revocation and final archive.

Security/Compliance constraints:
- Exports must be encrypted at rest using company-managed KMS key.
- External counsel accounts must be created with timebound guest accounts (expiring 2026-05-01) and logged to Access Review.
- No broad team defaults; explicit allow lists only.

Risks / Notes:
- Slack retention settings might require a workspace admin change; coordinate with Platform Directory team.
- Confluence export volume could be large (images/attachments); validate bucket lifecycle and permissions.
- External counsel may request SSO; confirm whether invitations can be SAML guest or require Google invites.

Requested timeline:
- Provisioning to be completed and validated by 2026-03-25 to allow rehearsal before the 2026-04-01 start.
